decisions.statement: A question names one page type.
The pages of that page type and of every page type extending that page type are answered.
A page type is reached however far below the named page type that page type extends.
A row has the page type its own page states rather than the page type named.
That page type is a slug, however the page spells the address reaching that page type.
A question tests and orders on that slug as a row carries it.
Those pages are read from the index.
A page type nothing extends that no page is filed under is answered empty.
A name that is no page type is refused rather than answered empty.
Whether a name is a page type is read from the index.
A test this module does not run is refused rather than dropped.
A test stating nothing is refused rather than narrowing nothing.
The tests this runs are the ones `where-testing` names.
A key the page type declares nothing for is refused rather than left out.
A key is refused wherever a question names that key.
A refusal names the keys the page type does declare.
A page type declares its own keys and the keys of every page type above that page type.
A key is the property slug a property page states rather than the slug reaching that page.
A row has the keys the question names.
A question naming no key is answered with every key a page has.
A key a page does not have stands in no row.
A key the page type declares that no page carries is answered rather than refused.
A calculation the rows carry is worked out over every row a question answers.
A calculation over one page is the calculation that page's own page type declares.
A question testing or ordering on a calculated key works every calculation out first.
A question testing and ordering on no calculated key narrows before working any out.
A question whose rows carry no calculated key works no calculation out.
A calculation is worked out over the rows taken rather than over every row gathered.
A calculation reaches every page gathered however few rows are worked out.
A key a calculation answers is answered as a stored key is.
A calculation answering absent puts no key in the row.
A calculation is read from the code file beside the page declaring that property.
A property whose code file is not there darkens that property's key alone.
A question naming a key a calculation refused is refused.
A question naming no darkened key is answered without the darkened keys.
Rows are ordered by the key the question sorts on.
Rows are ordered by path where the question sorts on nothing.
Rows are skipped before rows are taken.
An answer counts every page matching before any row is skipped or taken.
An answer is written out row by row and stops once past what it may carry.
The values a page keeps outside the commit are read from the file beside that page.
The uncommitted values are written over the values the index has.
The values a page keeps beside the page are read from the file the page names.
The values read beside the page are answered in place of the extension stated.
A file beside a page that will not read refuses the question.
The properties a page type declares are answered as its shape.
A shape names every property the page type and the page types above that page type declare.
A declaration is keyed as a page's file spells that key.
A declaration is titled by its own property slug written in start case.
A declaration has the property page's own id.
A declaration has the page type a property points at.
A declaration has the values a select property states.
A name that is no page type is shaped as nothing rather than refused.
A shape states the owner the nearest page type above the shape's own page type names.
No page's own file is opened.
Nothing here has an answer for a later question.
Nothing here writes.

definition: a question put to the pages, and the rows it answers with
